description: This file contains implementations of socket and file descriptor management functions, including setting non-blocking mode, reading random bytes, duplicating file descriptors, and sending/receiving messages over sockets with ancillary data, within the Android platform.

classes.name: RpcTransportCtxFactory
classes.description: Factory class for RPC transport context creation.

classes.name: RpcTransportCtxFactoryRaw
classes.description: Implementation of RpcTransportCtxFactory that provides a raw transport context.

classes.name: RpcTransportFd
classes.description: Represents a file descriptor used for RPC transport.

methods.name: setNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a file descriptor to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: getRandomBytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes from /dev/urandom.

methods.name: dupFileDescriptor
methods.description: Duplicates a file descriptor with CLOEXEC flag.

methods.name: makeDefaultRpcTransportCtxFactory
methods.description: Creates a default RPC transport context factory.

methods.name: sendMessageOnSocket
methods.description: Sends a message over a socket, optionally with ancillary file descriptors.

methods.name: receiveMessageFromSocket
methods.description: Receives a message from a socket, extracting ancillary file descriptors if present.
